# uzc_ssh_keys (Data Source)

Lists SSH keys registered with UzCloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_ssh_keys" "all" {}

output "ssh_key_slugs" {
  value = [for k in data.uzc_ssh_keys.all.ssh_keys : k.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ssh_keys` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_keys))

### Nested Schema for `ssh_keys`

- `public_key` (String)
- `slug` (String) Use this as `ssh_key` on uzc_virtual_machine.
